Halloween might seem like a harmless celebration, but the truth behind its origins tells a darker story. In this video, we uncover the shocking pagan roots of Halloween that every Christian should know. From ancient rituals of human and animal sacrifices to practices of necromancy and divination, Halloween was deeply rooted in the worship of false gods. As believers, we are called to stand apart and not participate in traditions that have their origins in evil. Discover the truth about what this holiday really celebrates and why no Christian should take part.

Watch now to uncover the real story behind Halloween's disturbing past.
